description: This Java source file defines the SoundAlarmListenerService class, which extends WearableListenerService. It handles data change events from a Wear OS device, specifically listening for an 'alarm_on' signal to play or stop an alarm sound at maximum volume, and restores the original volume when the alarm stops.

classes.name: SoundAlarmListenerService
classes.description: A service listening for data changes indicating to start or stop an alarm sound, managing alarm playback and volume adjustments.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the service, setting up AudioManager, saving original volume, and preparing MediaPlayer.

methods.name: onDestroy
methods.description: Restores the original alarm volume and releases the MediaPlayer resources.

methods.name: onDataChanged
methods.description: Handles incoming data events; plays alarm sound when 'alarm_on' is true, stops and resets volume when false.
